note: The phase-exit contract. Every phase has completion criteria a machine can check; `evidence.sh gate <phase>` evaluates them and is the ONLY way a phase may be marked exited. This file exists because the evidence checks E1-E14 all ask 'is what you said true?' and none of them can ask 'did you do the thing this phase exists to do?' — so a phase that was skipped entirely used to pass a clean audit in silence. Criteria are defined in skills/sycl-review/references/phase-exit-criteria.md.
hotspot_pct_threshold_note: A kernel at or above this share of e2e wall-clock in profile/e2e.baseline.json is a hotspot, and the optimize phase may not be left until each hotspot has either a measured trial or a recorded reason for having none.
max_gate_attempts_note: Failed gate -> fix the gap, or record a waiver with a reason and blast radius, then re-gate. After this many failed attempts, stop refining and escalate: record the unmet criteria as a blocker and say so in the report. A gate loop that never terminates burns the budget that the remaining phases need.

scope.note: The work-item denominator, frozen when inventory exits. Check E17 fails any id that later disappears without a matching entry in `changes` — a result stays comparable to the plan it started from, and 'pending: 0' can never be reached by re-cutting the inventory at a coarser granularity.
